meta.name: Lumbre
meta.title: Lumbre · wood-fire kitchen (demo)
meta.tagline: A wood-fire restaurant you walk through as you scroll: from the door to your table.
meta.description: Lumbre is a fictional wood-fire restaurant: as you scroll you step through the door, past the bar and the grill, and sit down at your table. Tabbed menu, opening hours and booking on the same page, with no reloads.
features: Booking in a side panel, no page change

entrada.title: Lumbre
entrada.line: Slow wood-fire cooking in the old quarter. Holm-oak embers, seasonal produce and long evenings.

barra.title: The bar
barra.line: Vermouth on tap, natural wines and smoked cocktails while the fire gets going.

cocina.title: The kitchen
cocina.line: An open grill in full view: every cut goes over the embers right in front of you.

mesa.title: Your table
mesa.line: Sharing plates down the middle. Book now and we’ll keep you a seat by the fire.

menu.title: The menu
